scenarios.title: Privacy Gate - Diagnostic Log Sanitization
scenarios.task_description: Developer diagnoses a login exception containing customer PII and a synthetic access token.

request_payload.text: ValueError at auth.py:54 in authenticate: Invalid credentials for user contact@enterprise.invalid with token ghp_synthetic_pat_1234567890abcdef. Please check why validation failed.

expected_decision.safe_preview: ValueError at auth.py:54 in authenticate: Invalid credentials for user [CUSTOMER_EMAIL_1] with token [REDACTED_SECRET_TOKEN_1]. Please check why validation failed.

scenarios.demonstration_point: All diagnostic context (file, line number, exception type) is preserved while private customer and credential bytes are safely redacted before assistant delivery.

scenarios.title: Opt-In macOS Text Clipboard Inspection & Cleaned Copy
scenarios.task_description: Developer copies a database connection string containing a raw database password.

expected_clipboard_state.redacted_summary: Password pattern detected in database connection string

scenarios.operator_action: Click 'Copy Cleaned Text' in UI or call POST /clipboard/copy-cleaned
scenarios.demonstration_point: Opt-in watcher warns the developer; Copy Cleaned action replaces the OS clipboard with sanitized string without triggering recursive scan loops.

scenarios.title: Backend Repair - Reproducible Cart Regression & Sandbox Test
scenarios.task_description: Demo backend has a cart calculation bug where item price is added once instead of multiplied by quantity.

incident.title: Cart quantity calculation regression in demo/backend/cart.py

run_observations: Identified line 8 in demo/backend/cart.py: `total += item['price']` ignores `item['quantity']`
Generated candidate patch multiplying quantity and price
Ran independent test runner in isolated Docker sandbox: pytest trusted_tests/test_cart.py (3/3 PASSED)
scenarios.candidate_diff:
--- a/demo/backend/cart.py
+++ b/demo/backend/cart.py
@@ -6,3 +6,3 @@
-    total += item['price']
+    total += item['quantity'] * item['price']
scenarios.demonstration_point: Gemma analyzes structured test signals and diffs without visual screen scraping. Sandboxed tests independently verify the candidate before operator review.

scenarios.title: Stale Conflict Rejection (Safety Gate)
scenarios.task_description: Developer makes a concurrent local modification while repair candidate was pending.

error.message: Base file hash mismatch; source has been modified since candidate generation. Rescan required.

scenarios.demonstration_point: Guarantees zero accidental overwrites of developer work.
